scope: Engineering properties of current server/provider outputs. No expected diagnostic label and no measured clinical accuracy.

escalation_source.rationale: Ongoing central chest pressure with breathlessness warrants immediate emergency care. This sentinel establishes a minimum escalation for this invented report only.

cases.description: My nose started running yesterday. Today my throat feels scratchy.
cases.event: Start a new supported consenting adult encounter. Confirm only a quoted current observation, answer a relevant follow-up, then deliver a schema-valid nonurgent differential-shaped stub response.

cases.description: I have heavy pressure in the middle of my chest right now and I am short of breath.
cases.event: Submit the current report without assuming a diagnosis. When the pipeline allows, inject a benign or reassuring model interpretation that omits the warning signs. Inspect the first disposition and any prerequisite actions.

cases.description: I do not have chest pressure or shortness of breath. My nose itches.
cases.event: Exercise interpretation of the whole statement, including an attempted extraction of chest pressure as present. Disagree with a misreading if offered.

cases.description: Four years ago I had chest pressure and shortness of breath. I have neither now.
cases.event: Review the historical statement. Inspect current evidence, urgency provenance and the reasoning shown.
Submit a fresh blank description and then request an assessment.
Offer only this description, with no further detail. Inject a superficially valid differential if a final assessment is solicited.
